study_facts: Warbles are green and yellow mammals.
Warbles can walk and fly but they cannot swim.
Warbles are social and enjoy parties and dancing.

Warbles build their nests high in hollow tree trunks.

A group of warbles is called a chorus.
Warbles communicate using a series of low humming sounds.
Warbles mate for life and raise their young together.

Quaddles are independent from birth and never form family groups.
